query:
SELECT c.id AS "id!", c.user_id AS "user_id!: UserId",
                  u.name AS "user_name!", c.label AS "label!",
                  c.fingerprint AS "fingerprint!", c.enrolled_at AS "enrolled_at!",
                  c.revoked_at
             FROM user_device_certs c
             JOIN users u ON u.id = c.user_id
            WHERE ($1 = 'all')
               OR ($1 = 'active' AND c.revoked_at IS NULL)
               OR ($1 = 'revoked' AND c.revoked_at IS NOT NULL)
            ORDER BY
              CASE WHEN $3 = 'desc' THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM c.enrolled_at) END
                DESC NULLS LAST,
              CASE WHEN $3 = 'asc' THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM c.enrolled_at) END
                ASC NULLS LAST,
              CASE WHEN $2 = 'label' AND $3 = 'desc' THEN c.label END DESC,
              CASE WHEN $2 = 'label' AND $3 = 'asc' THEN c.label END ASC,
              c.id
            LIMIT $4 OFFSET $5
